new_libraries.name: PacketLED
new_libraries.author: Luca Soltoggio
new_libraries.sentence: Packet communication over bidirectional LEDs, inspired by Packet Radio.
new_libraries.paragraph: Two boards exchange packets through a pair of ordinary LEDs: each LED both transmits and senses light, no photodiode needed. LX.25 protocol with CRC-16/X.25, acknowledgements and retransmissions, 256-1024 bit/s. LoRa-style API.

new_libraries.name: sensorShieldLib
new_libraries.author: makio135
new_libraries.sentence: Easily monitor sensors and communicate values in JSON on changes.
new_libraries.paragraph: sensorShieldLib provides methods to easily declare sensors, monitor their values, process them if needed, set limits and/or sensitivities, and finally communicate the values in JSON on changes, without dependencies.
